applies_to: LG MultiSITE MS8350 (VUCQMS8350) room controllers for commercial and hotel fan coil units.
summary: The MS8350 is LG's MultiSITE touchscreen room controller for fan coil units. It is a BACnet MS/TP application specific controller (B-ASC) with about 280 objects: room and outdoor temperature, setpoints, system and fan mode, fan and universal outputs, alarms, display and configuration values, Wi-Fi status and paired ZigBee wireless sensor objects.
notes: Access follows the guide's object-property tables: AV, AO, BV, BO and MSV present values are commandable, CSVs writable, and AI/MSI present values only writable while Out_Of_Service is TRUE.
The guide gives no description column, only default, range and a units/state column; descriptions here show the printed default and range.
Some object names print the subscript 2 of CO2 out of place (e.g. 'CO level 2'); they are written as CO2 here (AV 106 'CO2 level').
Wireless Device objects only report data for paired ZigBee Pro sensors.
The guide mentions 10 program (PG) objects for LUA4RC scripts but does not list them.

source.title: MultiSITE MS8000 Series Room Controllers BACnet Integration Guide (MS8350 VUCQMS8350, MS8650 VUCQMS8650)

integration.summary: Command occupancy with MV 10, mode with MV 16 and fan mode with MV 17, and write the occupied setpoints AV 39/AV 40. Read AV 100 room temperature, MI 33 effective occupancy and MV 112 control status.

minimum_points.name: Occupancy Command
minimum_points.why: BMS occupancy: local, occupied or unoccupied

minimum_points.name: Control Status
minimum_points.why: Current state: off, cooling or heating

minimum_points.name: Service Alarm
minimum_points.why: Service alarm from an input set to Service

integration.enable: The BMS writes MV 10 Occupancy Command (1 = Loc. occ; 2 = Occupied; 3 = Unocc.) and MV 16 System Mode. MV 110 chooses whether local occupancy follows motion or the schedule.
integration.remote_sensors: The guide does not describe feeding room temperature from the BMS. MV 145 selects the wired, internal or a paired ZigBee wireless sensor, and MI 312 Effective Temperature Sensor shows which one is in use. Writing an AI present value only works with Out_Of_Service set TRUE.
setup: BACnet MS/TP baud rate is MV 8 (9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 76800, 115200 or Auto; default Auto). Max_Master is writable, 0-127, default 127.
AV 10 COM Address holds the MS/TP address. Device Object_Identifier and Object_Name are writable; no default device instance is printed.
MI 317 BACnet IP Status shows whether BACnet IP is enabled; separate Wi-Fi objects report the Wi-Fi module state.
The controller is a B-ASC with COV, time synchronization and an internal schedule (SCHED-I-B); it does not support segmented requests or responses.
gotchas: For the MS8350 the guide says writes at some priority levels go to EEPROM (locked at the controller and kept through a power cycle until released at the same priority or by Restore Factory Default) and others to RAM (lost on a power cycle), but it does not print which priority numbers fall in each group.
On the MS8350 the relinquish default is the value set at the thermostat and it survives power cycles; on the MS8650 the relinquish default of AV 100 and above is read-only.
Keep Read Property Multiple requests small; segmentation is not supported.
